[S5 NOTE] The detection in an Athlete's Sample at all times or In-Competition, as applicable, of any quantity of the following substances subject to threshold limits: formoterol, salbutamol, cathine, ephedrine, methylephedrine and pseudoephedrine, in conjunction with a diuretic or masking agent (except topical ophthalmic administration of a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor or local administration of felypressin in dental anaesthesia), will be considered as an Adverse Analytical Finding (AAF) unless the Athlete has an approved Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE) for that substance in addition to the one granted for the diuretic or masking agent.

PL27-0324.title: MECLOFENOXATE
PL27-0324.tags: Food / meat contamination; Permitted medication or product as possible source; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0324.note: Meclofenoxate degrades rapidly to 4-CPA, which can also come from food with 4-CPA herbicide residues or from the non-prohibited chlorphenesin / chlorphenesin carbamate. Before an AAF, exclude these sources (Table 1: meclofenoxate > 50 ng/mL = AAF; 4-CPA > 5 µg/mL is an AAF only if no chlorphenesin Metabolites are detected). 'B' Sample: confirmation of 4-CPA is sufficient.

PL27-0324.title: MINIMUM REPORTING LEVELS APPLIED IN DOPING CONTROL
PL27-0324.note: TD MRL Art. 3.2.2: a finding at or below the MRL is reported as an ATF when the Analyte is identified together with a diuretic or masking agent (which, if it has an MRL, must itself be above its MRL).

PL27-0267.title: MEBEVERINE METABOLISM
PL27-0267.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance
PL27-0267.note: p-Hydroxyamphetamine (p-OH-A), a Metabolite of amfetamine, selegiline and famprofazone, can also come from the non-prohibited antispasmodic mebeverine. Before an AAF based on p-OH-A, confirm the absence of mebeverine acid and desmethyl mebeverine acid.

PL27-0267.title: MINIMUM REPORTING LEVELS APPLIED IN DOPING CONTROL
PL27-0267.tags: Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0267.note: TD MRL Table 1 (selegiline): 'metamfetamine and amfetamine may also be present in a Sample as Metabolites of selegiline. The MRL also applies to these free (non-conjugated) phase-I Metabolites.' Metamfetamine: the MRL is applied independently to the d- and l-enantiomers, which the Laboratory shall separate chromatographically.

PL27-0084.title: ANALYSIS AND REPORTING OF ZERANOL
PL27-0084.tags: Food / meat contamination; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0084.note: Zeranol and its Metabolites zearalanone and taleranol may result from mycotoxin (zearalenone) contaminated food, including meat from animals fed contaminated grain. Test zearalenone, α- and β-zearalenol and the zearalenone/zeranol, α-zearalenol/zeranol, β-zearalenol/taleranol ratios; elevated ratios = Negative Finding.

PL27-0084.title: Minimum Reporting Level for Certain Substances Known to be Potential Meat Contaminants
PL27-0084.tags: Food / meat contamination; ATF and mandatory investigation; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0084.note: Used as growth promoters in livestock – possible meat contamination. Above the MRL of 5 ng/mL: AAF; at or below 5 ng/mL: ATF, and the RMA shall conduct a mandatory investigation of contaminated meat consumption (Stakeholder Notice 1 June 2021). Clenbuterol/zilpaterol: free parent only; ractopamine and zeranol: total content; zeranol also TL04.

PL27-0311.title: OXILOFRINE
PL27-0311.tags: Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Analytical interference or artefact; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0311.note: Oxilofrine is formed from ephedrine: with ephedrine ≤ DL, oxilofrine ≤ 1,000 ng/mL = Negative Finding, > 1,000 ng/mL = AAF (without ephedrine the MRL of 50 ng/mL applies). Hydroxy-pseudoephedrine (minor pseudoephedrine Metabolite) can co-elute with oxilofrine in LC-MS: chromatographic separation (e.g. GC-MS of TMS derivatives, UHPLC) is required before an AAF.

PL27-0311.title: DECISION LIMITS FOR THE CONFIRMATORY QUANTIFICATION OF EXOGENOUS THRESHOLD SUBSTANCES
PL27-0311.note: TD DL Art. 4: an exogenous Threshold Substance found at or below its DL together with an identified diuretic or masking agent is reported as an AAF when the three conditions are met (SG ≤ 1.018, SG-adjusted concentration > DL, diuretic without MRL or above its MRL); for SG > 1.018 the DL is adjusted (Art. 7).

PL27-0007.title: IN SITU FORMATION OF EXOGENOUS COMPOUNDS IN URINE SAMPLES
PL27-0007.note: Microbial in-situ formation from endogenous steroids: androst-4-ene-3,17-dione; Δ1-steroids (boldenone, boldione, androst-1-ene-3,17-diol); prednisone and prednisolone from cortisone/cortisol; 19-norsteroids (19-NA, 19-NE) by demethylation; free testosterone. PL27-0007.title: IN SITU FORMATION OF SPECIFIC SUBSTANCES WITH A STEROID STRUCTURE
PL27-0007.tags: In-situ formation / Sample degradation; Second opinion / expert review
PL27-0007.note: Can be formed in situ by microbial transformation of endogenous steroids. At low concentrations (below the MRPL): extract before hydrolysis, evaluate the Metabolite pattern (e.g. phase-II Metabolites); a written second opinion from another Laboratory is recommended before an AAF.

PL27-0007.title: Detection of Synthetic Forms of Prohibited Substances by GC/C/IRMS
PL27-0007.note: 1-en-steroids > 10 ng/mL without extensive degradation: GC/C/IRMS shall be performed; ≤ 10 ng/mL: Negative Finding unless GC/C/IRMS is performed (not required if consistent with confirmed exogenous boldenone).

PL27-0007.title: Detection of Synthetic Forms of Prohibited Substances by GC/C/IRMS
PL27-0007.note: GC/C/IRMS positivity criteria (Δδ¹³C ERC–TC): T > 3.0 ‰ with 5αAdiol or 5βAdiol > 3.0 ‰ (or both Adiols > 3.0 ‰); E > 4.5 ‰; 5αAdiol > 4.0 ‰ with δ¹³C ≤ −27.0 ‰ (e.g. DHT administration); 7β-OH-DHEA, DHEA, 19-NA, 19-NE > 3.0 ‰; 1-en-steroids, boldenone, BM1 > 4.0 ‰ (TD IRMS Art. 6.1.2 and Table 3).

PL27-0020.note: Findings are based on 19-NA (and 19-NE). 19-NA is also a minor Metabolite of the contraceptive norethisterone and can occur in pregnancy: for female Athletes, pregnancy and norethisterone use must be excluded (hCG test; tetrahydronorethisterone ratio) and stated in the Test Report; GC/C/IRMS per TD NA / TD IRMS.

PL27-0020.title: HARMONIZATION OF ANALYSIS AND REPORTING OF 19-NORSTEROIDS

PL27-0369.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Analytical interference or artefact; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0369.note: Oxymorphone can be a GC-MS artefact (thermolysis / TMS derivatization) of the permitted μ-opioid antagonist methylnaltrexone (MTNX). When confirmed by GC-MS, confirm the absence of MTNX by LC-MS; Negative Finding if MTNX present and no LC-MS CP for oxymorphone is possible.

PL27-0369.title: MINIMUM REPORTING LEVELS APPLIED IN DOPING CONTROL
PL27-0369.note: TD MRL Art. 3.2.2: a finding at or below the MRL is reported as an ATF when the Analyte is identified together with a diuretic or masking agent (which, if it has an MRL, must itself be above its MRL).

PL27-0079.title: ENOBOSARM (OSTARINE)
PL27-0079.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0079.note: O-dephenyl-ostarine can be an impurity / minor Metabolite of the permitted drug bicalutamide. AAF for enobosarm only when enobosarm and/or its glucuronide are confirmed – 'not … based only on the presence of O-dephenyl-ostarine'.

PL27-0079.title: Dried Blood Spots (DBS) for Doping Control Requirements and Procedures for Analytical Testing and Sample Storage
PL27-0079.note: Included in the TD DBS Minimum DBS Testing Menus, which 'the Laboratory should validate and implement' (DBS MRPLs in Annex A).

PL27-0214.title: TRIMETAZIDINE
PL27-0214.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0214.note: Trimetazidine can be a Metabolite of the permitted migraine drug lomerizine. Check the DCF; include lomerizine and its M6 Metabolite in the CP; Negative Finding if consistent with lomerizine (e.g. trimetazidine not higher than M6).

PL27-0257.title: DIFFERENCE IN “A” AND “B” SAMPLE URINE CHARACTERISTICS
PL27-0257.note: Colour/turbidity differences between 'A' and 'B' urine Samples: do not reject; document before opening, inform the Testing Authority, analyse 'A' preserving volume; TA investigates the collection and alerts the APMU.

PL27-0257.title: Urine Sample Tampering or Attempted Tampering
PL27-0257.note: Suspected urine Tampering: initial assessment (appearance, SG < 1.001, pH < 4 or > 9, suppressed steroid Markers, endogenous substances such as AICAR, cortisol, cortisone, proteolytic activity), further assessment (creatinine < 20 mg/dL, conductivity < 1 mS/cm, atypical compounds) and DNA profiling for substitution; AAF or ATF per Art. 3.

PL27-0257.title: Athlete Passport Management Unit Requirements and Procedures
PL27-0257.note: TD APMU Art. 8.9: urine exchange established from the urinary steroid Markers and/or DNA across several Samples is reported by the APMU to the Passport Custodian; mixed DNA profiles within one Sample or other evidence of manipulation (substitution, mixing of urines, addition of proteases) can lead to an AAF or ATF for Tampering.

PL27-0364.title: HYDROMORPHONE
PL27-0364.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0364.note: Hydromorphone can come from the permitted hydrocodone (include hydrocodone and norhydrocodone in the CP; Negative Finding if total hydromorphone ≤ either) and from high doses of morphine (or codeine): with morphine present, AAF only if hydromorphone > MRL and hydromorphone/morphine ratio > 0.05.

PL27-0364.title: MINIMUM REPORTING LEVELS APPLIED IN DOPING CONTROL
PL27-0364.note: TD MRL Art. 3.2.2: a finding at or below the MRL is reported as an ATF when the Analyte is identified together with a diuretic or masking agent (which, if it has an MRL, must itself be above its MRL).

PL27-0366.title: HYDROMORPHONE
PL27-0366.tags: Also a Metabolite / product of another substance
PL27-0366.note: High doses of morphine can produce hydromorphone as a minor Metabolite – relevant when evaluating hydromorphone findings (ratio criterion 0.05).

PL27-0366.title: ETHYLMORPHINE
PL27-0366.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0366.note: Morphine > DL may result from the permitted drug ethylmorphine (EtM). Include EtM and nor-EtM in the CP: Negative Finding if total morphine ≤ total EtM or morphine/nor-EtM ≤ 20; AAF only if both criteria are exceeded (with a standard Test Report comment).

PL27-0366.title: MINIMUM REQUIRED PERFORMANCE LEVELS FOR NON-THRESHOLD SUBSTANCES ANALYZED BY CHROMATOGRAPHIC - MASS SPECTROMETRIC ANALYTICAL METHODS
PL27-0366.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance
PL27-0366.note: Confounding factors (TD MRPL Table 4): codeine and ethylmorphine metabolise into morphine – monitor codeine (+ glucuronide), EtM and nor-EtM (see TD DL, TL22).

PL27-0366.title: DECISION LIMITS FOR THE CONFIRMATORY QUANTIFICATION OF EXOGENOUS THRESHOLD SUBSTANCES
PL27-0366.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Also a Metabolite / product of another substance; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0366.note: TD DL: in the presence of codeine (C), an AAF for morphine (M) requires total M > DL and M/C ≥ 2.00, except if C > 5.00 µg/mL (only codeine intake: Negative Finding, M need not be quantified); in the presence of ethylmorphine, the TL22 criteria apply (M/EtM and M/nor-EtM) with a set Test Report comment.

PL27-0366.title: DECISION LIMITS FOR THE CONFIRMATORY QUANTIFICATION OF EXOGENOUS THRESHOLD SUBSTANCES
PL27-0366.note: TD DL Art. 4: an exogenous Threshold Substance found at or below its DL together with an identified diuretic or masking agent is reported as an AAF when the three conditions are met (SG ≤ 1.018, SG-adjusted concentration > DL, diuretic without MRL or above its MRL); for SG > 1.018 the DL is adjusted (Art. 7).

PL27-0164.title: TRETOQUINOL
PL27-0164.tags: Permitted medication or product as possible source; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0164.note: Tretoquinol is an ingredient of OTC cold and flu medications (and an asthma drug in some Asian countries). Target parent + glucuronide only; AAF only when the total exceeds 20 ng/mL (MRL).

PL27-0164.title: MINIMUM REPORTING LEVELS APPLIED IN DOPING CONTROL
PL27-0164.note: TD MRL Art. 3.2.2: a finding at or below the MRL is reported as an ATF when the Analyte is identified together with a diuretic or masking agent (which, if it has an MRL, must itself be above its MRL).

PL27-0165.title: DETECTION OF TULOBUTEROL IN THE PRESENCE OF BUPROPION
PL27-0165.tags: Analytical interference or artefact; Specific analysis / reporting rule
PL27-0165.note: A derivative of bupropion (Monitoring Program substance, not prohibited) can interfere with tulobuterol in LC- and GC-MS (near-identical spectra, retention-time shift at high bupropion). Validate with bupropion excretion urine; RT difference > 0.1 min; confirm the RT with a tulobuterol-spiked Aliquot – a new emerging peak means Negative Finding.

PL27-0180.title: IN SITU FORMATION OF TESTOLACTONE
PL27-0180.tags: In-situ formation / Sample degradation; Second opinion / expert review
PL27-0180.note: Testolactone can be formed in situ from DHEA by microbial Baeyer-Villiger oxidation. Extract before hydrolysis; confirm at least one major Metabolite (4,5-dihydro- or 1,2,4,5-tetrahydrotestolactone); a written second opinion from another Laboratory is recommended before an AAF.

PL27-0180.title: Analysis, Reporting & Management of Urinary Human Chorionic Gonadotrophin (hCG) and Luteinizing Hormone (LH) Findings in Male Athletes
PL27-0180.note: When the ITP gives a PAAF for LH (male urine), the Laboratory shall test the Sample for GnRH and its analogues, aromatase inhibitors and anti-estrogenic substances (part of the standard testing menu); a confirmed one = AAF, all negative = ATF for LH.

PL27-0008.title: IN SITU FORMATION OF SPECIFIC SUBSTANCES WITH A STEROID STRUCTURE
PL27-0008.tags: In-situ formation / Sample degradation; Second opinion / expert review
PL27-0008.note: Can be formed in situ by microbial transformation of endogenous steroids. At low concentrations (below the MRPL): extract before hydrolysis, evaluate the Metabolite pattern (e.g. phase-II Metabolites); a written second opinion from another Laboratory is recommended before an AAF.

PL27-0008.title: Detection of Synthetic Forms of Prohibited Substances by GC/C/IRMS

PL27-0008.title: Detection of Synthetic Forms of Prohibited Substances by GC/C/IRMS
